title: STNFS at relation excess 1.1 with line sieve to 2^48 and band strip, f-first ECM, weight-200 merge, ten LA owners, re-optimised descent: 120.6174

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, required relation excess 1.1 (the whole region is collected and every retained relation, >= 2^63.7216 = 1.206 U, is filtered and used by the descent; the matrix is charged with filtering tables measured at excess 1.1, an over-estimate of N at the larger actual excess), theta = 2581/8000 collection on a 150,000-draw pool (proof.md), the measured record route, the re-measured recentred slice12 kernel table (KERNELS.md), f-first cofactorisation with early abort, the weight-200 merge and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels with ten active owners returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.3904 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries, measured at weight 100 and 200 and at excess 1.1; the weight-200 ratio N(200)/N(100) <= 0.80 and N/U not rising above the measured 2^15..2^18 values at excess 1.1 are part of H3). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^120.6174 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to <= 2^120.6174 (2^120.6173626). ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; X2 = 2^64; theta=2581/8000 (4792 rows, a-radius 822; retained relations >= 2^63.7216, 0.1327 bits = 2.18 pool SE above 1.1 U) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0316, line sieve (scores only) for primes below 2^48 and record walk for [2^48, 2^64), survivors stripping (2^20, 2^48] primes by two rounds per side of the 48-bit ECM schedule (a missed band prime loses the relation, charged in the yield), alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 each and re-read at 7.003; the g-side band strip and ECM run only after the f side factors, charged with probability q_f = 100 rho(u_f)/P(omitted_f <= slack_f) per row: collection <= 2^120.2580 units (charged mean 319.4 instructions per cell). The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; the 62-node descent plan (v13's coordinate-search plan re-optimised by the same kind of coordinate search at the excess-1.1 inputs LOG2_RELS = 63.721 and mean norms 744.1/500.0: 30 entries move by one or two steps, boot unchanged; refinement.json) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: mean weight 201 after merging to weight 200, 20.7 instructions per sparse entry, 1,640 per row for the ten-owner six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 0.80 x 1.092 x 0.05934 U = 2^59.1814 < 10 x 2^56 at excess 1.1, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.8823 units, generator <= 2^107.2086. Descent credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation (relation-weighted E[shat/m]/pr >= 1.06 boot / >= 4.70 nodes, uniform cells), forces discard only up to 2^90, and keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^116.0558; the two-log meter is 2^116.785; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6032384. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.807e-03 per log, expected nodes 2^18.41, node abort 2^-8.89 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100 or 200 (default 200) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-200 LA, ten-owner row tail with owner_schedule check), retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 125 s natively; longer when emulated).
